presentation.body: Ster reads hidden representations from open-weight Llama-family models, measures what they encode, and changes generation with learned steering directions.
presentation.title: See and steer what a model represents

presentation.body: A steering direction starts with contrastive pairs. Each positive example should express the behavior you want while its negative partner provides a close, meaningful contrast.
presentation.title: Start with one contrastive pair

presentation.body: Authoring a pair set is local and does not load or download a model. The resulting JSON is the input used later by train, optimize, and evaluate.
presentation.title: Create the training input first

presentation.body:
Run:
ster pairs add --pairs ster-first-pairs.json --trait helpfulness --positive "Give a clear, direct answer." --negative "Give a vague, evasive answer."

This writes a reusable pair-set JSON file. Then run ster onboarding again to see the recorded completion.
presentation.title: Write your first Ster result
